title: The trip
text: There's money for one trip this year. A month at a real Muay Thai camp, his grandfather's old sambo club overseas, or the language school his parents keep mentioning.

choices.text: A month at the Muay Thai camp.
choices.outcome: Two sessions a day, a fight on the last night, and a win.
The old men there break him down every day and he loves it. He learns leg locks nobody back home has seen.

person.about: Coached sambo for forty years and still shows up to the club every day.

choices.outcome: He learns some French and a lot about being bored. He comes home hungry to start something real.
